claims.statement: For the governed half-skew BSSC, the attached deterministic binary64/NumPy discovery programs and frozen evidence ledger cover: both published exact 2x4x4x9 component laws under all 4^9 maps to the four BSSC super-inputs (524,288 evaluations); 48 full-joint W=U=V=4 runs of 20,000 Adam steps; 24 full-joint W=8,U=V=4 runs of 30,000 steps; 48 raw/reflected transplant continuations; a 33-run product/nonrectangular homotopy; a 90-run symmetry-reduced fixed-input sweep; a 78-run full-support orthogonal/map-mutation escape batch; and a validation-only stress test on all four three-symbol faces. In these finite recorded computations the maximum Marton half-weight value minus the canonical directed lower endpoint for the exact two-use randomized-time-division threshold is at most 10^-12 bits. The closest values replay the product-RTD basin within binary64 rounding; the best nontrivial escape value is 0.7232857353779031 bits, 3.34660062416488e-8 bits below the binary64 comparison value. This is a reproducible numerical non-finding only: it is not a proof of Marton additivity, not an upper bound on the unrestricted two-letter Marton functional, and not a BSSC capacity converse.
